title: Stop Breaking Tools
description: Prevents you from using tools when their durability is critically low, saving them from breaking.
body: Stop Breaking Tools prevents you from accidentally destroying your valuable tools by blocking their use when durability is critically low. Get a warning sound and action bar message the moment your tool is about to break, and configure the durability threshold, which tools are protected, and whether attacks or block breaking should be cancelled — all from an in-game config menu.
